label: sec:markov-axioms-braid-link-markov-closure-map-preamble
html:
Continuation of the preceding sub-section.

This sub-section records the F_3 \varepsilon^6 leading coefficient, identifies the categorical Markov closure map it belongs to, derives the canonical \mathfrak{Q}_\beta \gamma\gamma form, and extracts the c_k coefficients from the algebraic rules that the closure map supplies. The closing c_k extraction blocks specialise the substrate-level Markov machinery to the Habiro-coefficient framework consumed by the predicted-spectra chapter.
